title: TMA pipeline
description: Overlapping writes in a pipelined shared-memory allocation.

versions.label: Public PTX

raw.assumption_reporting: triggered=null means applicability was not measured or analysis was not reached

assumptions.label: Duplicate TMA stores
assumptions.text: Matching same-warp duplicate TMA stores are races in the model, but are reported as warnings under the assumption that their stored values agree.

assumptions.label: Representative election
assumptions.text: Election selects lane zero when participating, otherwise the lowest participating lane.

assumptions.label: Failed launch cancellation
assumptions.text: Every cluster launch cancellation request fails.

assumptions.label: Representative branches
assumptions.text: Choose fallthrough for an unresolved structured if/else; unknown ordinary instruction guards execute. Terminal control uses CFG classification. Known control and explicit choices take precedence.

assumptions.label: Bounded computation loops
assumptions.text: Execute a configured number of body iterations for unresolved recognized computation loops, counted separately per invocation. Polling and unclassified loops are never forced to complete.

assumptions.label: Order-independent atomics
assumptions.text: The kernel is correct for every order in which concurrent atomics (atom, red) on the same element take effect. Each atomic is one indivisible access; two atomics on the same element whose scopes include both threads do not race.
